title: 移動床生物膜反應器
summary: MBBR以移動載體提供附著生物膜表面，水流、載體混合與供氧共同影響反應。學徒區分名目填充比例、受保護面積、實際活性與攔網通水。
summaryEn: MBBR uses moving carriers for attached biofilm; flow, carrier mixing and oxygen jointly affect reaction. Distinguish fill fraction, protected area, actual activity and retaining-screen hydraulics.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 可生物降解進料：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Biodegradable feed: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 可生物降解進料：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Biodegradable feed: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「可生物降解進料」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at biodegradable feed.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「可生物降解進料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for biodegradable feed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「可生物降解進料」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。

Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moving-bed effective volume: Hydraulic retention time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「移動床有效反應容積」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at moving-bed effective volume.

steps.checkEn: Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for moving-bed effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。
隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut.
quiz.explanation: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「移動床有效反應容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for moving-bed effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
